items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: there's this girl, Sadie playing, uh, not Sadie.

ctx.x: Was Tom Anderson's a very, uh, jumping place? What happened there?

Well, that was about the most exclusive place they had around here at that time. Uh, Tom Anderson. Uh, Tom Anderson. Uh, it stayed back because, uh, we had another place there on, uh, Bienville between Ramport and Burgundy. Oh, I forgot, I forgot the name of the place. But anyway, that was where Manuel, uh, what's the name, Manuel Pures or somebody. Uh, I think, uh, who was playing trumpet around there. Uh, like, Big O was playing drums. And, uh, there's this girl, Sadie playing, uh, not Sadie. Uh, uh, Emma…
Yeah, man, you could run and keep up with that train though. Walk fast, you could keep up with it.
